s0CCCB6.name: Cutscene: castle tiles, scroll and shake states
summary: Group of cutscene routines using [$1442] as scene state, [$143F]/[$1441] as timers, [$1440] as animation frame.
$0CCCB6: draws a 3x2 grid of 16x16 castle tiles (OAM slots 1-6) from DATA_0CCC9F, frame chosen by [$1440], palette flashing.
$0CCD23: state - screen scrolls up with a shake until Y scroll = $C0, then queues a tile strip upload.
$0CCDA1: state - screen drops with increasing speed ([$1447], max $7F), shaking, until Y position >= $A8.

s0CCE40.name: Table: animated 4-tile row frames
summary: Two frames of four 16x16 tile numbers ($80-$83, mirrored); indexed by [$1440]*4.

s0CCE48.name: Cutscene: draw animated 4-tile row
summary: Flips [$1440] every 6 frames and draws four 16x16 tiles in a horizontal row from X=$98, Y=[$0B42] (OAM slots 1-4).
Second frame is X-flipped.

s0CCEA3.name: Table: spinning sprite tiles and properties
summary: Tile numbers then OAM props for a 4-frame spin ($25/$65 = X flip).

s0CCEAB.name: Cutscene: draw spinning sprite
summary: Draws one 16x16 sprite at X=$B0, Y=[$0B43] in OAM slot 12, frame advancing every 2 frames.

s0CCED4.name: Tables: animation frame and duration per step
summary: DATA_0CCED4: [$1440] frame for each sequence step; DATA_0CCEDB: frame duration (written to [$143F]).

s0CCEE2.name: Cutscene state: falling object then frame sequence
summary: Moves actor 2 under its Y/X speed while toggling frame; when Y >= $5C it has landed and a table-driven frame sequence plays ([$1447] = step).
Plays sound $08 on step 1; advances the scene state on step 6. Then draws the object via $0CCF49.

s0CCF3B.name: Tables: landed object tiles and properties
summary: Tile numbers and OAM props, indexed by [$1440] (0-6).

s0CCF49.name: Cutscene: draw object and wait states
summary: $0CCF49: draws an 8x8 sprite at X=[$0B52], Y=[$0B43] using [$1440] (hidden when $FF).
$0CCF72: state - waits through four 4-frame animation steps, then advances. $0CCFC5 is a sibling wait state.

s0CCF9F.name: Table: sprite tile numbers
summary: Four 16x16 tile numbers indexed by [$1440].

s0CCFA3.name: Cutscene: sprite draw, exit and sub-scene states
summary: $0CCFA3: draws a 16x16 sprite at ($AC,$63) with tile from DATA_0CCF9F (quirk: tile number is also used as the OAM prop).
$0CCFC5/$0CCFF7: wait states. $0CCFDE: final state, once [$1443] and [$144D] are 0, any of B/Y/A/X resets the state and sets game mode $0B.
$0CD003: state driven by sub-scene [$143E] (timers, layer 1 X shake, castle sprite counter-shifted against the shake).

s0CD061.name: Table: puff effect tiles and properties
summary: Four 8x8 tiles ($7C,$7D,$7D,$7C) with props $30/$F0 (lower pair flipped).

s0CD069.name: Cutscene: effects near Mario and scroll states
summary: $0CD069: draws a 2x2 group of 8x8 pieces at Mario X/Y + $10 (OAM slots 1-4).
$0CD0BC-$0CD19C: scene states keyed to [$143E]: scroll screen down, ease screen and puff effect ($1A sound), layer 2 Y shake.

s0CD1A7.name: Stripe image data: two rows of 8 tiles
summary: Stripe format: VRAM address (hi,lo), flags/length (hi,lo; length-1), then tile/prop byte pairs; $FF ends the data.
Two rows at VRAM $20B3 and $20D3, each 8 tiles (C0-C5 / D0-D5 with mirrored ends).

s0CD1D0.name: Queue tile strip for upload
summary: Copies the 41 bytes of DATA_0CD1A7 into the stripe image buffer at $7F837D (indexed by [$7F837B]) and advances the index by $28.

s0CD1F0.name: Stripe image data: three-tile RLE row
summary: VRAM $20F4 then $2114: RLE (flag $40) runs of 3 tiles $F8 with prop $00; terminated with $FF.

s0CD1FD.name: Table: VRAM addresses for three columns
summary: VRAM tilemap addresses, 8 rows each ($20 apart), for columns at $20F4, $20F6 and $20F8 (24 entries).

lines.0CCCBB: A = offset of this frame's row in tile table DATA_0CCC9F (6 tiles per frame)
lines.0CCCC4: Frame $FF is drawn 8 pixels further right
lines.0CCCC8: $00 = X position of the current tile
lines.0CCCCA: $04 = X position of the start of a row
lines.0CCCCE: $02 = Y position of the current row = $57
lines.0CCCD4: A = tile number from the table
lines.0CCCD7: Skip this tile if it is 0 (empty cell)
lines.0CCCE5: Palette flash only when bit 1 of the frame is set
lines.0CCD01: } OAM size bit for this slot = 2 (16x16 sprite)
lines.0CCD0F: After 3 tiles, start the second row
lines.0CCD20: Loop until 6 tiles (3x2 grid of 16x16) are written
lines.0CCD23: Cutscene state: scroll screen upward with a shake. X = actor 0 (the camera)
lines.0CCD27: Has the screen Y scroll reached $C0?
lines.0CCD2B: Yes: stop the shake, layer 1 X scroll = 0
lines.0CCD31: Actor 0 Y position (low) = screen Y scroll (low)
lines.0CCD36: Actor 0 Y position (high) = screen Y scroll (high)
lines.0CCD3B: Actor 0 Y speed = $F0 (-1 pixel per frame, 4.4 fixed point)
lines.0CCD3E: Apply Y speed to actor 0 Y position
lines.0CCD41: Shake: layer 1 X scroll +/- 1 on alternate frames
lines.0CCD56: Yes: [$1444] = 1 (flag: spawn the falling object sprite)
lines.0CCD6D: Queue the 2-row tile strip (DATA_0CD1A7) for upload
lines.0CCD7C: Moving up: keep moving until its Y position < $68
lines.0CCD85: Moving down: A = actor 1 Y position
lines.0CCD8C: Yes: advance to the next scene state
lines.0CCDA1: Cutscene state: screen drops with growing speed and shakes
lines.0CCDBB: Actor 0 Y position = screen Y scroll
lines.0CCDD1: Shake while the screen Y is 0 or below $20
lines.0CCDDA: Screen Y scroll = actor 0 Y position
lines.0CCDEC: At or above $20: actor 1 Y speed = 8
lines.0CCDFD: Advance to the next scene state
lines.0CCE0B: Moving up: stop once Y position < $68
lines.0CCE14: Moving down: stop once Y position >= $78
lines.0CCE24: [$0B43] = $77 - actor 0 Y: object Y relative to the scrolled screen
lines.0CCE2D: X = $14: OAM offset for the 2x2 sprite
lines.0CCE3B: Y position of the 2x2 sprite = $5F - screen offset
lines.0CCE6E: Y = [$1440] * 4: row of 4 tiles in DATA_0CCE40
lines.0CCE91: } OAM size bit for this slot = 2 (16x16)
lines.0CCEBD: Y = (frame counter & 6) / 2: animation frame 0..3, changes every 2 frames
lines.0CCEC7: OAM prop: $25 or $65 (X flip), so the object spins
lines.0CCEE2: Cutscene state: object falls and bounces, then plays a frame sequence
lines.0CCEE7: [$1440] >= 2: it has landed, go to the sequence
lines.0CCEFF: A = Y position of the object
lines.0CCF14: Timer expired: step [$1447] to the next entry of the sequence
lines.0CCF1C: A = animation frame for this step (DATA_0CCED4)
lines.0CCF35: Advance to the next scene state
lines.0CCF72: Scene state: wait 4 animation frames. Count down timer
lines.0CCF8D: Draw the sprite for the current frame
lines.0CCF90: X = 8: OAM offset for the 2x2 sprite
lines.0CCFAC: Y = $21 (unused: the tile number is stored as the prop below)
lines.0CCFAE: OAM prop = tile number (looks like a bug)
lines.0CCFD8: Timer expired: advance to the next scene state
lines.0CCFDE: Final state: wait for [$1443] and [$144D] to be zero
lines.0CCFE6: Check controller 1: B, Y (byetUDLR) or A, X (axlr) pressed
lines.0CCFF7: Scene state: advance once [$1443] is set, then fall into the exit check
lines.0CD019: Sub-scene 2: while the timer is >= 8, draw the puff effect
lines.0CD020: Draw the 2x2 effect at Mario's position
lines.0CD043: Timer expired: advance to the next scene state
lines.0CD048: Compensate the shake: layer 1 X scroll shifts the sprite the opposite way
lines.0CD08D: A = prop ($30,$30,$F0,$F0: bottom pieces flipped X and Y)
lines.0CD0A4: After 2 pieces, start the lower row
lines.0CD0C3: Advance to the next scene state
lines.0CD0C9: Scene state: if a sub-scene is running...
lines.0CD0D2: Scene state (sub-scene 1 only): scroll screen down at speed 8
lines.0CD0DB: Actor 0 Y position = screen Y scroll
lines.0CD0F0: Y position 0 or < 9: just store it
lines.0CD0F6: Moved far enough: advance to the next scene state
lines.0CD100: Screen Y scroll = actor 0 Y position
lines.0CD108: Scene state (sub-scene 2 only): screen drifts and puff effect
lines.0CD11B: Draw the puff effect near Mario
lines.0CD12F: Advance to the next scene state
lines.0CD14F: Actor 0 X speed = $E8 (about -1.5 pixels per frame)
lines.0CD16F: Scene state: shake layer 2 Y position by +/- 1 every other frame
lines.0CD198: Advance to the next scene state
lines.0CD1A3: Advance to the next scene state
lines.0CD1A7: VRAM $20B3, flags 0, length-1 = $0F: 8 tile+prop pairs C0..C5, flipped C1, C0
lines.0CD1B7: flipped C1, C0 (prop 41); next: VRAM $20D3, length 16 (second row)
lines.0CD1C7: tiles D4, D5, then flipped D1, D0; $FF ends the stripe
lines.0CD1D0: Y = $28: index of the last byte of the strip
lines.0CD1D4: X = Y + [$7F837B] (current end of the upload buffer)
lines.0CD1DC: Copy to the stripe buffer at $7F837D
lines.0CD1EB: Buffer index += $28 (the $FF terminator is overwritten next time)
lines.0CD1F0: VRAM $20F4, RLE flag $40, length-1 = 2: 3 tiles $F8 (prop $00); next VRAM $2114
lines.0CD1F8: RLE 3 x tile $F8 prop $00; $FF ends the stripe
lines.0CD1FF: VRAM addresses $2114,$2134,...: rows down the column (step $20 = one row)
lines.0CD065: Props: 30,30,F0,F0 (bottom pair X and Y flipped)
